title: REQ · A timed-out agent attempt returns ErrTimeout and is retried then marked FAILED
summary: Per-attempt timeout is exposed as ErrTimeout and participates in the retry loop
description: Context: runAttempt wraps each agent call in context.WithTimeout but the resulting error is a bare context.DeadlineExceeded. Desired: export ErrTimeout and wrap it (alongside DeadlineExceeded) when an attempt times out so callers and tests can identify it. Expected: with MaxRetries 1 the agent runs twice and the execution ends FAILED with ErrTimeout. Why: operators need a distinguishable timeout failure.
acceptance_criteria: Given the agent blocks and Timeout is 20ms and MaxRetries is 1, When Run is called, Then agent.calls is 2
Given the same setup, When Run returns, Then errors.Is(err, ErrTimeout) and errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) are both true and the stored status is FAILED
Given the parent context is cancelled before timeout, When an attempt ends, Then the error does not wrap ErrTimeout

in_scope: ErrTimeout var and wrapping in runAttempt

technical_constraints: Go multiple %w wrapping already used in runner.go
definition_of_done: ErrTimeout exported and wrapped only on attempt deadline
